name: Leonis Krebele
original_name: レオニス・クレベール
source:
Star Sign: Sagittarius
Hobby: Antiques
Special Skill: Judging Antiques
Likes: Glassworks
Dislikes: People who wrong the royal family
Treasure: A pendant he got from the queen

A member of the royal guards who protect the royal family. He also runs the apprentice knight training school.
His swords skills are top rate, probably the 1st or 2nd best in the country.
The type who only talks when absolutely necessary.
He's good at taking care of people and is sort of a guardian towards the knight apprentices, [url=/c45889]Gazel[/url] and [url=/c45872]Sylphis[/url].
